elegantProofs.coreInsight: Any injective map g : Space4 → Space4 preserves equality classes iidClasses(g ∘ xs) = iidClasses(xs) identically.
elegantProofs.contrastWithBruteForce: Rather than writing separate measure-jacobian or combinatorial invariance proofs for ℝ⁴ translations, continuous SO(4) rotations, Euclidean time-reflection θ, and coordinate permutations, all four reduce to proving injectivity in 2–4 lines.

elegantProofs.leanExcerpt:
lemma iidClasses_map {n : ℕ} (xs : Fin n → Space4) (g : Space4 → Space4)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    iidClasses (fun i => g (xs i)) = iidClasses xs := by
  unfold iidClasses; congr 1; funext i; ext j
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact ⟨fun h => hg h, fun h => congrArg g h⟩

elegantProofs.title: Zero-Friction Borel Typeclass Unification Across Arbitrary SU(N) Instances
elegantProofs.coreInsight: Two BorelSpace instances on the same TopologicalSpace share Borel sets: rw [instB.measurable_eq, (canonSUBorel N).measurable_eq]; subst h_eq.
elegantProofs.contrastWithBruteForce: Dependent type theory normally traps downstream users when [MeasurableSpace] diamonds differ between modules. Equating instM = canonSUMeas N via BorelSpace.measurable_eq transports the entire 106-module proof across arbitrary instances cleanly.
elegantProofs.payoff: Lets global theorems quantify over completely unconstrained [MeasurableSpace] [BorelSpace] typeclasses with zero friction.
elegantProofs.leanExcerpt:
noncomputable def unconditional_balaban_hypothesis (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    [instM : MeasurableSpace (SU N)] [instB : BorelSpace (SU N)] :
    BalabanRGContinuumHypothesis N hN := by
  have h_eq : instM = canonSUMeas N := by
    rw [instB.measurable_eq, (canonSUBorel N).measurable_eq]
  subst h_eq
  exact YangMills.iidBalabanHypothesis N hN
